description_short: Automatic factory and mine-tower logistics with status semaphore antennas.
description: Automatic logistics control for factories and mine towers with storage/sorter thresholds, save-integrated rules, and three-light status semaphore antennas.
description_long: Automatic factory control based on storage levels plus Mine Tower control of manually selected Ore Sorting Plants. Includes player-owned pause cycles, segmented indicators, spatial breakdown fireworks, and automatic UI localization for all 20 Captain of Industry languages.
